sources.title: Jeannine K. Brown, Just a Busybody? A Look at the Greco-Roman Topos of Meddling for Defining allotriepiskopos in 1 Peter 4:15, Journal of Biblical Literature 125.3 (2006), 549–568
sources.claimLimit: Author-uploaded published text was inspected at the introduction, lexical discussion, Greco-Roman meddling analysis, and conclusion. Brown argues that the meddling/interference constellation is the best semantic-social frame and that the term likely concerns movement outside culturally appropriate social boundaries with possible political ramifications. Her proposal is one peer-reviewed argument, not consensus; narrower labels such as informer, revolutionary, embezzler, or errant bishop are not treated as lexically certain.
